course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Summarize a short real-world update and add a concise personal reaction.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A local service or community update affects routines for the week.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Extracting the main point, explaining the effect, and giving a brief opinion.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a short local update about changed opening hours, transport, or service access and decide how it affects their week.

main_focus.name: summary plus reaction in two clear steps
main_focus.description: Separate the source summary from a personal reaction using B2-ready framing language.
model_examples: Kort sagt ändras öppettiderna under två dagar.
Min reaktion är att det är rimligt, men lite opraktiskt.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2 summary frames and 2 personal-reaction frames naturally in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: subordinate clauses with att and eftersom

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use source-summary chunks together with everyday service vocabulary.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions a short update that needs to be understood quickly.
dialogue_shape.middle: They identify the main point, one practical effect, and one reaction or concern.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide how to adapt during the affected period.

target_complexity.repetition: summary and reaction should remain distinct

focus: the main point of the update
the practical effect on the week
the personal reaction and reason behind it

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with Kort sagt
one sentence with Det viktigaste är att
one sentence explaining practical effect with påverkar
one sentence giving a personal reaction
one sentence concluding what needs to be done
